name: course.md Authoring Toolchain
description: Installs the shared authoring toolchain used by course.md-based course repositories.

version.description: Git tag or ref of course.md to install into the container.

slides.description: Install browser and sandbox dependencies needed for slide preview and export.

ocr.description: Install OCR tooling used by some course authoring workflows.

latex.description: Install a minimal LaTeX toolchain for PDF-oriented workflows.

linters.description: Install shared Node.js-based linters and formatting tools such as markdownlint-cli and Prettier.
